title: build(turbo): hash the Service Worker generator into the Console's build and type-check only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbS1Z33XiLfwgAvkxHrZ2Diq)_

Fixes #29361

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Service Worker 生成器 `ui/packages/mobile/src/serviceWorkerSource.ts` 不再挂在根 `turbo.json` 通用 `build` / `type-check` 的输入上,改挂到 Console 自己的 `ui/apps/console/turbo.json`(带 `$TURBO_EXTENDS$`,根输入照常继承)。通用 `test` 输入保留。ui 的两个 turbo 输入守卫改为按「turbo 对该包实际解析出的输入」判定,能读懂包级 `turbo.json`。
- **为什么改**:改一行生成器会让所有 `@object-ui/*` 包的 build/type-check 缓存失效,实际只有 Console 读它。总监在 PR #29326 合同复审里提的 should-fix。
- **风险与回滚**:只动缓存键,不动构建产物;不发布任何包,无 changeset;`ci.yml` 未动,`check:ci-filter-parity` 绿。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/turbo.json`(两条 inputs 必须带 `$TURBO_EXTENDS$`,否则 Console 的根输入全丢);`ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/turbo-inputs.ts` 的 `packageTaskInputs`;`turbo-build-inputs.test.ts` 新增的逐包 `$TURBO_DEFAULT$` 断言。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm exec turbo run build type-check --filter=@object-ui/console --filter=@object-ui/core --dry=json`,给生成器末尾加一行注释再跑一次:Console 两个 hash 变,core 两个不变。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- Root `turbo.json`: the generator leaves the generic `build` and `type-check` inputs. The generic `test` input stays, because the root ui vitest config loads the Console's `vite.config.ts`.
- `ui/apps/console/turbo.json`: `build` and `type-check` declare `["$TURBO_EXTENDS$", "$TURBO_ROOT$/ui/packages/mobile/src/serviceWorkerSource.ts"]`, so the Console keeps every root input and adds the generator.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/helpers/turbo-inputs.ts` (ruling A, claim amendment 6581882409): `packageTaskInputs` resolves a package's task inputs the way turbo does. No `inputs` on the package task inherits the root list; a list holding `$TURBO_EXTENDS$` is the root list plus its entries; a list without it replaces the root list. A root `PACKAGE#TASK` override for the package throws, because the reader does not implement that shape. `packageTurboConfig` narrows the package config like the root one.
- `turbo-build-inputs.test.ts` and `turbo-type-check-inputs.test.ts`: each package row is judged against its resolved list. The phantom-input and earned-input assertions also cover each package's own `$TURBO_ROOT$` entries, earned only by that package's program. The build suite gains a per-package assertion that the resolved list still carries `$TURBO_DEFAULT$`. No rule is loosened, no row exempted, no assertion deleted.
- New `turbo-inputs-package-config.test.ts`: fixtures for each resolution, the throw cases, and live-tree pins (Console build/type-check hash the generator plus the root list; `@object-ui/core` build/type-check do not; every package's `test` still does).

No changeset: nothing here ships. `@object-ui/console` publishes `dist`, `plugin.*` and `README.md` only; the rest is repo tooling. `skip-changeset` is set on this PR.

## Tests

Hash proofs, `turbo run build type-check test --filter=@object-ui/console --filter=@object-ui/core --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --dry=json` (turbo 2.11.10), before and after appending a comment to the generator:

<details><summary>main (6af3d295): every package's build and type-check move</summary>

| task | before | after edit |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `@object-ui/core#build` | 341838eef8262e54 | 078a70f287b05963 |
| `@object-ui/core#type-check` | b0e7109c12bb4885 | b968c1ef54b40528 |
| `@object-ui/console#build` | 7af14fd740b2d419 | a23ad7dc8c5a851e |
| `@object-ui/console#type-check` | 86aaf22d49bf1e02 | 3d185b303fac6359 |

`@object-ui/core` does not depend on `@object-ui/mobile` (its build closure has 4 tasks, none of them mobile's), so its move came from the input alone.
</details>

<details><summary>this branch: only the Console's build and type-check move; every test still moves</summary>

| task | before | after edit |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `@object-ui/core#build` | 6c35a1e42b0e1130 | 6c35a1e42b0e1130 (unchanged) |
| `@object-ui/core#type-check` | 9cb5b96291a6bf06 | 9cb5b96291a6bf06 (unchanged) |
| `@object-ui/core#test` | 14e60fabf5d09a61 | ce70e0cf375c9560 |
| `@object-ui/console#build` | 94196d2f1d9d4d72 | 1c05c0f359ea0ac5 |
| `@object-ui/console#type-check` | 514067ed9666bd87 | 1d9746d5003f1d35 |
| `@object-ui/console#test` | ec433433ddf5f4d2 | 2b676d5bdf2fa74e |
| `@object-ui/app-shell#test` | f52cfbe7090d54f6 | b669ea12779cae1f |

`@object-ui/console#build` hashes 457 files, the same count as on main, with all 9 `ui/scripts/vite-*.ts` root inputs present. `@object-ui/app-shell#build` still moves because it depends on `@object-ui/mobile#build`, not through the input.
</details>

<details><summary>$TURBO_EXTENDS$ is load-bearing</summary>

With the marker removed from `ui/apps/console/turbo.json`, `@object-ui/console#build` hashes 3 files (`$TURBO_DEFAULT$` and the root list are gone). With the marker written last instead of first it hashes the same 457. Restored from HEAD after each probe, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Reverse checks on the suites</summary>

- Old reader (helper and both suites restored from 6af3d295) with the new turbo configs: exit 1, 2 failed / 82 passed, the `@object-ui/console` rows of both suites, each reading `serviceWorkerSource.ts` from outside `apps/console`. This is the red the ruling asked to teach away.
- New reader, marker dropped from the Console config: exit 1, 5 failed (both Console rows, the Console `$TURBO_DEFAULT$` case, two live-tree pins).
- New reader, Console inputs removed (generator hashed nowhere): exit 1, 4 failed (both Console rows, two live-tree pins).
- Each leg restored with `git checkout HEAD --`; `git status --porcelain` empty after.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The other turbo-input suites (`turbo-test-inputs`, `turbo-lint-inputs`) still read the root list only. No package config declares `test` or `lint` today, so their verdicts are unchanged; they can take `packageTaskInputs` when one does.
- `check:ci-filter-parity` reads root `turbo.json` only (its header names a package-level `turbo.json` as a known bound). The `core:` row for the generator stays, held by the generic `test` input. `ci.yml` is untouched.
- An open PR, #29488, also edits root `turbo.json`, in a `@objectstack/*#test` task about 600 lines away from these hunks. No overlap.

## Verification

On head 84365b1e (main merged at 6af3d295):

- `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`: exit 0 (self-test 138 assertions; 29 build inputs and 9 test inputs covered, no leftover).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the verify lock: exit 0, 170 files passed / 2 skipped, 4972 tests passed / 2 skipped.
- `pnpm --dir ui run type-check:scripts`: exit 0. `eslint` on the four changed ui files: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run lint:root`: exit 0, no warning in these files.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 31 derived. 27 exit 0. `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/` without a full `pnpm build`): NOT MEASURED locally, Build Core runs them on this PR. `--ran` reconciliation: 31 accounted, 27 run, 4 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the changed ui files and `lint:root` locally; the repo-wide run is CI's)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
